sources.note: Massey University's own scholarships-and-awards page for the Undergraduate International Study Grants, 2027 cycle, marked Status: Open.

awarding_body.detail: The page is on massey.ac.nz, Massey University's own domain, titled 'Undergraduate International Study Grants - Massey University'. It is the awarding body's own page, not an aggregator or news article.
awarding_body.quote: The Massey University Undergraduate International Study Grants support new to Massey students through a tuition fee contribution of NZ$15,000.

deadline.detail: No application deadline is published: there is no separate application and the grant is assessed at the point of admission. The page shows Status: Open for the 2027 intake cycle ('starting in any intake in 2027'), which is the currently open cycle, so the record's rolling 'assessed at admission' claim is accurate.
deadline.quote: Status: Open ... There is no separate application for the International Study Grant; you will be assessed at the point of admission, and, if successful, the grant will display on your admission offer of place.

eligibility.detail: Every distinct eligibility claim in the record is confirmed: new international students enrolling full-time for the first time at Massey in 2027; restricted to one of fifteen listed undergraduate degrees (exactly fifteen are listed on the page); onshore study in New Zealand; and students holding fully funded government scholarships (Fed Aid, SACM, Manaaki, TSLS or similar) are not eligible.
eligibility.quote: You will be new to Massey and enrolling full time in one of the following undergraduate degrees in 2027 ... Students who have received fully funded government scholarships are not eligible for the study grant. This includes but is not limited to Fed Aid, SACM, Manaaki, or TSLS.

funding.detail: The award is a tuition fee contribution of NZ$15,000, running for one year. It is not fully funded - no travel, living, or other costs are covered - which matches the record's 'Tuition Fee Waiver (NZ$15,000 towards tuition fees)' classification.
funding.quote: Value: NZ$15,000 towards tuition fees; Duration: One year duration

degree_levels.detail: The page states full-time undergraduate study and lists fifteen Bachelor's degrees (Bachelor Accountancy, Agribusiness, Agricultural Science, Arts, Aviation Management, Commercial Music, Communication, Design/BDes, Fine Arts/BFA, Food Technology with Honours, Horticultural and Plant Systems, Nursing, Resource and Environmental Planning, Screen Arts/BSA, Sport and Exercise). This matches the record's degree_levels of Bachelor's.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: No separate application for the International Study Grant; assessed at the point of admission for undergraduate degrees starting in any intake in 2027 (Status: Open)
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: All claims re-checked directly on Massey University's official page on 2026-10-12. Value NZ$15,000 towards tuition fees, one-year duration, full-time, undergraduate, onshore. Eligible intakes are any intake in 2027. The page links a regulations PDF (2027 International Study Grants, dated September 2026), which was not needed for the verdict because the HTML page itself states the value, restrictions, eligibility and application process. For a 2028-intake re-check, note the page will roll forward to 2028 intakes; also note Massey's separate Toroa International Undergraduate Fee Scholarship exists for degrees not on the fifteen-degree list.
